patterns.note: Tactile-to-digital transition: A rich, organic, full-bleed physical product hero image transitions immediately into a stark, pitch-black digital canvas.
Extreme scale contrast featuring oversized editorial quotes and a massive, screen-spanning footer wordmark that anchors the page.
Stark monochromatic base (pure black and white) that allows the warm, earthy terracotta tones of the hero photography to act as the primary visual anchor.
Scroll-triggered fade-in reveals for text blocks and testimonial quotes, creating a paced, editorial reading experience as the user scrolls down the dark canvas.

technique_notes: To recreate the hero section, use a high-resolution, full-bleed background image with a centered product mock-up embedded in a textured medium (like soil), overlaying crisp white navigation and a bottom-aligned headline.

Implement the scroll-reveal system using CSS keyframes combined with an intersection observer to smoothly fade and slide up text blocks as they enter the viewport, maintaining a smooth, cinematic pace.
For the footer, use a multi-column grid for secondary CTAs and links, capped off by an ultra-large, responsive wordmark that scales to span the entire width of the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, high-impact editorial headings and massive quotes (~4-5x body size) contrasted with clean, highly readable medium-weight body text.

standout: The site's defining feature is the striking contrast between the highly tactile, organic terracotta-soil hero image and the stark, pitch-black minimalist layout below it, capped by a colossal, screen-width footer wordmark.
